content.text:
Yes—**it belongs in `entireio/cli`, and the underlying hook failure still reproduces.**

- **Ownership:** Cursor is built into [Entire CLI](https://github.com/entireio/cli/tree/0138471ae764ca9b846ed21ce0a9ff917724d0bf/cmd/entire/cli/agent/cursor). There is no `entire-agent-cursor` implementation in `external-agents`.
- **Fresh reproduction:** Using installed Cursor Agent `2026.08.11-e8db854`, I ran identical prompts in a temporary repository with hook sentinels and explicit workspace trust:
  - Ordinary CLI mode: completed successfully; fired `sessionStart` and `sessionEnd`.
  - ACP mode: completed successfully; **fired no hooks**.
- **Still unhandled:** Entire `v0.10.6` and current `main` (`0138471ae764`) still install `.cursor/hooks.json` hooks, with no ACP integration. JetBrains uses [Cursor’s ACP mode](https://cursor.com/docs/integrations/jetbrains), so this remains consistent with the reported capture failure.

This was a direct ACP reproduction, not a full IntelliJ UI test; I also haven’t verified a newer Cursor binary.

I recommend transferring [#18](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/issues/18) to `entireio/cli` and keeping it open. The related [PR #35](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/pull/35) only documents the limitation and currently says `Closes #18`; merging that would not fix capture. I haven’t changed either issue or PR.
I’ll review PR #62’s diff, check the relevant code and tests, and report any actionable findings.
